svg.title: 오구오구 5959
svg.desc: Ogu-ogu 5959 (new.5959.site): anonymous emotion-sharing community where AI turns worries into monsters. Kotlin, Spring Boot 4, Next.js 16, Spring AI.
svg.text: Post a worry anonymously, AI turns the emotion
into a monster, and others cheer to defeat it.
Raid load test: 500 users, 0 lost HP updates
